base: frozen MAPPO u0 (frozen_u0.pt, clean2 A_checkpoint_000.pt), arm B plant settings as coop_probe

evaluation.acting_rule: planner acts iff seed-1 best adv LB95 > 0 (else no move, gain 0)
evaluation.observability: clean3 track2_backend rule at t0: member slots = self + K-1 nearest CAVs within 100 m; K=4 and K=6
evaluation.solos: all member solos on a seed iff the move is admitted vs base (adv LB95 > 0) there
evaluation.statistic: bank_statistics._stats per seed (30-s circular block / per-vehicle paired bootstrap B=2000), one-sided 95% lower bound
evaluation.synergy: J(best solo) - J(group); admitted iff LB95 > 0

owner_authority: owner-approved upper_bound phase (MAIN brief 2026-11-06), cap 150,000 sim-s, own ledger
radius: mainline (lane 0/1) CAVs with s in [-400, 75.44] m, policy-controlled at t0; any CAV regardless of its sensing slots

search.best: lowest J among searched multi-CAV candidates with no collision/teleport increase

selection: decision time t0 = the 5-s tick in [300,420] maximizing the full-information state score (min(#eligible mainline CAVs,6), #vehicles on the ramp merge lane in s[-100,75.44], sum 1/(1+v) over them, #mainline vehicles in s[-100,75.44]) among ticks with >=1 ramp vehicle in the merge zone (merge pressure) and >=2 eligible mainline CAVs (lane 0/1, s in [-400,75.44], policy-controlled at t0); ties -> earliest. State at t0 only, never an outcome.

vocabulary.member_sets: front-4, front-2, front-6, upstream-4 (eligible sorted downstream first)
vocabulary.plan: members follow seed-1 policy reference + offset; offset -depth in [o,o+h); release r>0 tapers linearly to 0 over r s; then live MAPPO resumes

worlds.rule: pass1 repeat-0 world per cell; pass2 repeat-1 for cells w/o moment; pass3 fill to 12
